title: CondoGuard Midterm Change Rates and Minimum Premium Change
content:
Rates of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy for midterm changes to Coverage A and Coverage C, the smallest prorated premium change that is billed or credited, and the association change period, by tier.

| Tier | Annual premium per 1,000 USD of Coverage A change (USD) | Annual premium per 1,000 USD of Coverage C change (USD) | Minimum prorated premium change billed or credited (USD) | Association change period (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 3.46 | 2.94 | 10.00 | 30 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 3.29 | 2.81 | 10.00 | 30 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 3.88 | 3.12 | 5.00 | 30 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 3.71 | 2.97 | 5.00 | 30 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 3.58 | 2.86 | 5.00 | 45 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 3.34 | 2.71 | 0.00 | 45 |

## What each column means

- **Rate per 1,000 USD of Coverage A change** and **rate per 1,000 USD of Coverage C change**: the annual premium for each 1,000 USD by which the coverage changes midterm.
- **Minimum prorated premium change**: a prorated midterm premium change below this amount is neither billed nor credited. On CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature the figure is 0.00.
- **Association change period**: the number of days after the association changes its master policy type or deductible within which the unit owner's coverage is brought into line.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

On CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced, a prorated premium change of 9.99 USD is below the 10.00 USD minimum and is neither billed nor credited; a change of exactly 10.00 USD is not below it. On CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier, where the minimum is 5.00 USD, the same 9.99 USD change is not below the minimum.
